text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I've just wrapped up training for the day
with
Kitasan Black when she pauses and
turns to me.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Would it be all right if I continue
training a little
by myself after this?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I don't know how to explain it, but... I
don't feel
like I've done enough running
today.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black's gaze is focused on
Satono
Diamond, who is still running
silently around the
track even now.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I can't afford to lose to Dia. I just can't!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I can't afford to lose to Dia. I just can't!
choice_data_list: Let's stick to our pace so we don't lose.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
choice_data_list: Let's stick to our pace so we don't lose.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Just like how sharing the weight of a
portable
shrine with everyone at a
festival makes me feel
more powerful...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I just know I'll be able to do great so
long as I'm
with you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After wrapping up our conversation,
Kitasan
Black and I do some extra
intense training
together.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Urgh... I know it's important to do things
in
moderation, but still...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
choice_data_list: In exchange, there's something I want to ask of you.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Of course! I'd be glad to if it'll help
improve my
running!
choice_data_list: I'd like your thoughts on the new menu...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. This combination of exercises can
definitely
help strengthen my
weaknesses...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Oh, could we increase the amount of
weight
lifting I do in this section?
Considering how I did
in my previous
scrimmage...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, I have a meeting with Kitasan
Black and
iron out a more efficient
training routine for her.
